mintAuthority.summary: USYC has materially unbounded native issuer issuance on Ethereum and Solana: Ethereum max-allowance minters and immediate token-owner upgrade control, plus Solana program-controlled mint and upgrade surfaces. BSC USYC is an issuer-operated Cross Chain Teller representation sourced from Ethereum; its bridge minter, Entitlements/admin, shared allowance, and token upgrade controls are scored under bridgeRouteRisk, not canonical Mint Authority.

controls.label: USYC Ethereum FundAdmin and max-allowance minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, this zero-code EOA was the current FundAdmin on the Ethereum RolesAuthority. It can immediately set any Ethereum minter allowance to uint256.max. It was itself an Ethereum max-allowance minter; max allowance is not decremented and USYC has no global supply cap. Its separate BSC route administration capability is scored under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: USYC Ethereum RolesAuthority owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, this zero-code EOA owned RolesAuthority 0x902d...808c. It could immediately grant or revoke the FundAdmin role and modify authority capability assignments, enabling a new unbounded native minter.

controls.label: USYC Ethereum token upgrade owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, this zero-code EOA was token owner. The UUPS implementation's _authorizeUpgrade is onlyOwner, so the account could replace native mint logic immediately with no on-chain delay. The current implementation still requires minterAllowance and does not give the owner a direct mint path by itself.

controls.evidence: This umbrella registry record preserves two independent immediate native upgrade domains solely because the current upgradeability schema accepts one controlRef. It does not represent one common signer or quorum: Ethereum owner 0x13ff...dd6 and Solana program upgrader P3S7...vb7B are separate keys. The BSC representation upgrade owner is scored under bridgeRouteRisk.

Solana USYC Teller and Permissions program

review.evidence: At exact cutoff Ethereum block 25526129, six accounts had uint256.max native minter allowance: Teller 0xeE35..., TokenMinterV2 0xfd78..., TokenManagerProxy 0x6A41..., PriceReporterProxy 0x9fde..., FundAdmin 0xDbE0..., and EOA 0x85fB.... The shared FundAdmin could immediately set new Ethereum max allowances, and the Ethereum RolesAuthority owner could change FundAdmin permissions. At Solana slot 432714278, the mint/freeze PDA was controlled by the documented Teller and Permissions program, whose ProgramData was previously associated with a no-delay upgrade EOA; the current ProgramData account could not be re-confirmed at the reviewed finalized slot. BSC USYC is an Ethereum-sourced Cross Chain Teller representation; its TokenMinterV2, shared EOA allowance, Entitlements owner, FundAdmin route capability, and token upgrade owner are scored under bridgeRouteRisk rather than native Mint Authority. No source supports the prior MPC/HSM custody assertion, so it is not repeated.
